grammar.summary: 本课论述准时的习惯，集中运用了倒装结构、虚拟条件句与定语从句。课文用 only 引导的倒装句强调只有农村才能忽视准时，用 if + would 虚拟条件句描述误车的后果，用 who/which 引导定语从句修饰知识分子与时间表。

points.title: 倒装结构 (Inversion)
points.explanation: only + 状语置于句首时主谓部分倒装，起强调作用。本课用 Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible... 强调只有人口稀少的农村才能无视准时习惯。

examples.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it.
examples.cn: 只有在人口稀少的农村，才可以忽视准时的习惯。

points.title: 虚拟条件句 (Conditionals)
points.explanation: 用 if 引导条件句，主句用 will/would 表示推测结果。本课用 if no accidents occur...they will be on time 描述「若路上无意外则准时到达」的条件推断，用 if you miss the train...have to wait 表示误车的后果。

examples.en: If no accidents occur on the way, like punctured tires, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time.
examples.cn: 要是路上没有发生如爆胎、改道、突然起雾等意外事故，他们决不会迟到。

examples.en: Although being early may mean wasting a little time, this will be less than if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one
examples.cn: 虽然早到可能意味着浪费一点时间，但这比误了火车等上一个多小时坐下班车浪费的时间要少。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 who/which 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 who 修饰 intellectual（知识分子），用 who 修饰 guest（早到的客人），用 which 修饰 timetable，使人物与事物描述具体。

examples.en: The intellectual, who is working on some abstruse problem, has everything coordinated and organized for the matter in hand.
examples.cn: 一个专心钻研某个复杂问题的知识分子，为了搞好手头的研究，要把一切都协调一致，组织周密。

examples.en: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance.
examples.cn: 客人提前半小时到达是令人讨厌的。

exercises.q: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community ______ possible to disregard it.
If no accidents ______ on the way, like punctured tires, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time.
The intellectual, ______ is working on some abstruse problem, has everything coordinated and organized for the matter in hand.
用倒装结构填空：Only in a sparsely-populated rural community ______ possible to disregard it.（填出倒装后的 be 动词与主语，如 is it）
